BJP Delays Jaipur Mayor Candidate Announcement Amidst Local Elections

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has not yet announced its candidate for the Jaipur Municipal Corporation Mayor post, with the nomination deadline set for the same day. The announcement was expected by late evening, potentially after deliberations at the Chief Minister's Residence. In contrast, the BJP announced its candidate for the Jodhpur Mayor post, selecting a specific individual for the position. The coverage focuses on the internal party process and candidate selection for these local urban body elections.
